description: Scratch defect: thin linear band of failures crossing the wafer. Notable: NO correlated process-sensor deviation detected. Negative evidence pushes root cause toward mechanical/handling causes rather than process excursion.
notes: KEY CASE: absence of sensor deviation is the signal here. The reasoning tool should rank mechanical/handling above process hypotheses precisely because no sensor shows deviation. Constructed scenario — not a real incident. See PRD Section 6 (non-obvious design point 1).
